أنبري (form VII)
# أَنْبَرِي (ʔanbarī) /ʔan.ba.riː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْبَرَى (inbarā)
# أَنْبَرِيَ (ʔanbariya) /ʔan.ba.ri.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْبَرَى (inbarā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
